that Pokémon!

head straight!

as the next battle zone—not till night falls!<U+0010><U+0001>븁
Lumiose sure is one exciting city, huh?

Here lies AZ, who mastered both creation and
destruction, a man of beginnings and endings.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
For 3,000 years he lived, finding no fellowship
with others as he wandered the world’s byways.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
But in Lumiose he discovered faithful friends and
was reunited with his most beloved Pokémon.<U+0010><U+0001>븁
It was in Lumiose, too, that he breathed his last.
